lines.q: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?
lines.a: Nineteen eighty nine! On the ninth of November.

lines.q: Which famous gate stood right by the Wall?
lines.a: The Brandenburg Gate! Right on the border.

lines.q: What was the most famous crossing point called?
lines.a: Checkpoint Charlie! Now a busy tourist stop.

lines.q: How many years did the Berlin Wall stand?
What's the longest surviving painted section called?
lines.a: The East Side Gallery! Over a kilometre of art.

lines.q: Last one. When did Germany reunify?
lines.a: October nineteen ninety! Got all six? Go again!
